html: Great! I have some ideas for census regions for Earth (here) and Mars (here), I intend to make pages for one state in each region, to provide an idea of what each is like in various ways. One of the ways is politically, do you have any idea what the general party strength is in regions of the US? I'd figure the only strong indicaters presently would be 1) Liberationists having a strong base in the La Plata region, as it's pre-annexation population didn't flee offworld in the course of the war and 2) United Republicans might have strong presences in resettled mexican states and recently annexed states (the Borneos, South African states).
